thesis: 핵심 수치는 대부분 cutoff-valid 10-K·10-Q·proxy에 직접 연결된다. 제품매출·volume/price·OCF·capex·R&D·부채·자사주·내부통제는 1차 자료로 확인된다. 가장 중요한 한계는 RF다. 약 47.6% 증분수익률은 공시 ROIC가 아니라 순이익 증가와 debt+equity 증가를 결합한 분석 proxy이며, acquired IPR&D·M&A·운전자본의 시차가 섞인다. 따라서 공식 ROIC처럼 단독 사용하면 안 된다.

evidence.claim: Q2 2026 revenue increased 48% to about $23.0B, driven by 60% volume growth and partly offset by a 13% realized-price decline; reported net income was about $7.1B.
Q2 10-Q directly reports H1 2026 OCF of $16.023B, capex of $5.259B, cash/investments of $12.806B and debt of $54.908B.
Q2 Mounjaro and Zepbound revenue totaled $14.871B, about 64.7% of consolidated revenue; this concentration calculation is arithmetic on issuer-reported product revenue.
FY2025 10-K states management concluded ICFR was effective at year-end and Ernst & Young issued an unqualified audit opinion on the financial statements and ICFR.

RF's ~47.6% incremental earnings/capital figure is an analyst proxy using FY2024-2025 net-income change divided by change in debt plus equity. It is not company-reported ROIC and is sensitive to acquisitions, IPR&D, financing and working capital.
The 2026 proxy documents independent standing committees and performance-linked executive compensation, supporting the governance evidence used by MA.

counterevidence: Standard CFO-capex overstates distributable owner cash if acquired IPR&D and M&A are economically recurring reinvestment.
Q2 revenue growth is unusually strong and should not be extrapolated linearly into the 10-year Base path.
Product concentration calculations are robust, but the economic correlation among tirzepatide, orforglipron and retatrutide remains judgmental.
Manufacturing capex normalization timing is not directly observable from current filings.
unknowns: Normalized maintenance versus growth capex after the current manufacturing buildout.
Full-cycle returns on 2025-26 acquired IPR&D and acquisitions.
Long-run realized net-price trajectory for metabolic products.
Independent adherence/persistence data by product and payer cohort.
A clean company-reported incremental ROIC series.
falsifiers: Future filings reveal a restatement, material weakness or source-definition change affecting core evidence.
Reported cash conversion weakens after capacity comes online while RF proxies remain high only because of acquisition/accounting timing.
Product-price or volume figures used in the frozen analysis materially diverge from source-verified values for the same cutoff.

key_kpis.name: Owner FCF/share + acquired IPR&D
key_kpis.threshold: cash conversion improves without external R&D/M&A rising faster than value creation

key_kpis.name: Volume / realized price / gross margin
key_kpis.threshold: volume growth offsets net-price pressure without structural margin erosion

key_kpis.name: Product concentration
key_kpis.threshold: successors and non-metabolic franchises reduce dependence on Mounjaro/Zepbound
